stories.title: Você viu? Álbum musical de Cleitinho, casa no interior e deputada federal mais jovem de MG

en.title: You saw? Cleitinho's musical album, house in the interior and youngest federal representative from MG
en.summary: Newly elected governor of Minas Gerais Cleitinho Azevedo has recorded a music album containing 15 songs before assuming office.

stories.title: Ataque russo na Ucrânia deixa 12 mortos, incluindo crianças, diz Zelensky

en.title: Russian attack on Ukraine leaves 12 dead, including children, says Zelensky
en.summary: A Russian bombing in Ukraine killed 12 people according to President Volodymyr Zelensky, who linked the attack to the suspension of sanctions on Moscow's oil exports.

stories.title: Lideranças de Lula e Flávio Bolsonaro no Ceará traçam estratégias de campanha para o 2º turno

en.title: Leaders of Lula and Flávio Bolsonaro in Ceará outline campaign strategies for the runoff
en.summary: Political groups allied with Lula and Flávio Bolsonaro in Ceará are mobilizing local leaders to campaign for their presidential candidates in the second round of elections.

stories.title: Lula e Flávio têm disposições diferentes para debates no 2º turno e estratégias de ataque e defesa

en.title: Lula and Flávio have different dispositions for debates in the runoff and attack and defense strategies
en.summary: Lula and Flávio Bolsonaro have different approaches regarding debate participation and campaign strategies for the second round of voting.

stories.title: Brazil Poll Gives Flávio Bolsonaro 52.8%, Lula 47.2%

en.title: Brazil Poll Gives Flávio Bolsonaro 52.8%, Lula 47.2%
en.summary: A poll of 5,026 Brazilian voters shows Flávio Bolsonaro leading President Lula by 5.6 percentage points, representing a shift from AtlasIntel's previous survey.

stories.title: Senador eleito mais jovem da história é antigo aliado do bolsonarismo e defendeu voto impresso

en.title: Youngest Elected Senator in History is Former Bolsonarism Ally and Supported Printed Voting
en.summary: Filipe Barros, 35, was elected senator for Paraná and will be the country's youngest senator on record since the early 20th century, representing a Bolsonaro-aligned political generation.

stories.title: Aos 21, maranhense apoiada por Sarney e prefeito investigado é deputada estadual mais jovem do país

en.title: At 21, Maranhense Supported by Sarney and Investigated Mayor Becomes Country's Youngest State Deputy
en.summary: Natália do Júnior Garimpeiro, age 21, was elected as the country's youngest state deputy with backing from former president José Sarney.

stories.title: Resultado da eleição redefine fila de cotados ao STF com Flávio Bolsonaro ou Lula

en.title: Election Result Reshapes Queue of Candidates for Supreme Court with Flávio Bolsonaro or Lula
en.summary: The election's first round results have altered prospects for Supreme Court appointments, with the incoming president able to make at least four nominations amid rightward Senate shifts and impeachment pressure.

stories.title: Mobilização online pró-Lula liga alerta na campanha de Flávio Bolsonaro, que contra-ataca

en.title: Online mobilization for Lula triggers alert in Flávio Bolsonaro's campaign, which counter-attacks
en.summary: Internet mobilization supporting President Lula's reelection has prompted his opponent Flávio Bolsonaro's campaign to launch counter-offensives on WhatsApp.

stories.title: Trabalharemos para que relação com Brasil avance, diz China sobre eventual eleição de Flávio Bolsonaro

en.title: We will work for Brazil relations to advance, China says on possible Flávio Bolsonaro election
en.summary: China's Foreign Ministry expressed willingness to advance relations with Brazil in response to Flávio Bolsonaro's lead in presidential voting intentions, with the latest Datafolha poll showing him at 52% versus Lula at 48%.

stories.title: Eleição nos EUA pode definir futuro de eventual aliança de Trump e Flávio

en.title: U.S. election may define future of eventual Trump and Flávio alliance
en.summary: If Flávio Bolsonaro wins Brazil's presidential election on the 25th, his strategic partnership plans with the United States may depend on the outcome of the U.S. presidential election.

stories.title: Senador, seu voto ficará na História: 10 razões para o fim da 6x1 na quarta

en.title: Senator, your vote will be in history: 10 reasons for the end of 6x1 on Wednesday
en.summary: Senate President Davi Alcolumbre scheduled a vote for the following Wednesday on ending the 6x1 work shift schedule, representing a chance for Congress to modernize 19th-century labor relations.

stories.title: Mobilização online pró-Lula liga alerta na campanha de Flávio Bolsonaro, que contra-ataca

en.title: Online mobilization for Lula triggers alert in Flávio Bolsonaro's campaign, who counter-attacks
en.summary: President Lula's reelection campaign intensifies social media mobilization, alarming rival Flávio Bolsonaro's team, which launches counter-offensives via WhatsApp. Since the first round, Lula's supporters have strengthened digital strategies to expose opponents and drive turnout for the second round.

stories.title: Isaias enfraquece para furacão de categoria 1 após tocar o solo na Flórida, diz NHC

en.title: Hurricane Isaias weakens to category 1 after landfall in Florida, says NHC
en.summary: Hurricane Isaias rapidly weakened to category 1 after making landfall near Destin, Florida. The U.S. National Hurricane Center warned of dangers from storm surge and flooding as power lines were damaged.

stories.title: Kassio baixa regra para acelerar análise de ações de propaganda no TSE após críticas

en.title: Kassio lowers rule to accelerate analysis of electoral propaganda actions at TSE after criticism
en.summary: The president of Brazil's Superior Electoral Court issued new rules to speed up judgment of electoral advertising cases ahead of the October 25 runoff election. The measures follow concerns about delayed decisions and concentrated power among court leadership.

stories.title: Anitta declara voto em Lula e critica Flávio Bolsonaro

en.title: Anitta declares vote for Lula and criticizes Flávio Bolsonaro
en.summary: Singer Anitta announced her support for presidential candidate Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva in the October 25 runoff, criticizing Bolsonaro's movement and acknowledging she underestimated its electoral strength.

stories.title: Furacão Simon ganha força na costa do Pacífico do México e ameaça região turística

en.title: Hurricane Simon strengthens off Mexico's Pacific coast and threatens tourist region
en.summary: Hurricane Simon intensified off Mexico's Pacific coast with sustained winds of 177 km/h and is expected to reach Category 4 strength by Saturday, threatening popular beach resorts and fishing villages in the southwestern and central-western regions.
